title: Minecraft Creeper Farm 1.21 - New Mechanic - 10,000+ Per Hour!
description:
Hello Guys TheySix is here With a New Minecraft Tutorial, In This Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a new creeper farm by using calibrated sculk sensors in Minecraft 1.21

📚This farm is extremely fast and can produce +900 ~ +10000 Gunpowder Per Hour ! 
📚This farm is so efficient and I highly recommend this farm, it takes about 1 - 3 hours to build.
📚This farm is working with a calibrated sculk sensor on each platform these new items have a fast reaction so they will activate the trapdoors so fast and due to this mechanic you can increase the speed of the farm
📚Important : Best Difficulty [ Hard ] - Render Distance [ 6 - 8 ] - Simulation Distance [ 6 - 7 ] - Best Location for this farm [ High heights locations, Deep Ocean Biomes[All-Types], Spawn-Proofed areas and Perimeter
📚If you want to build this farm on the land be sure to start the building at y = 240 and if you want to build this farm on top of the ocean you can start the building from y = 140.
📚You can add more layers to the farm ( recommended number of layers is 12 )
